metadata.name: Vigorous
metadata.subject: subject_demo
metadata.description: Subject demo's median over 290 minutes on 18 days (2023-05-11 to 2025-05-11) where the workout label is one of Running, HighIntensityIntervalTraining, StairClimbing, Elliptical or Cycling. A proxy for Vigorous, not a labelled state. The resting level, 77.2 bpm, is the median of the pipeline's daily level over 121 days. Only 290 minutes qualify, so this median is weak.
